title: FA-100S FULL ARMOR HYAKU SHIKI KAI (GOLDEN WARRIOR)
summary: The second part continues from https://youtu.be/kCtVfv52Pzc as they are the same model kit Golden Warrior from Shenma (God Horse).
body: The second part continues from https://youtu.be/kCtVfv52Pzc as they are the same model kit Golden Warrior from Shenma (God Horse).
The Hyaku Shiki Kai was a pleasant experience from start to finish. But this Full Armor is where the problems begin. Many of them.

The first one is the peg in the backpack which was intended for the base in flight mode, is now the connector for backpack extension. Now you can only rely on the basic connector at the waist for base display and it's... weak. Don't fly your kit too high above ground or you would break the antenna.

Then the arms. It has no metals except the shoulder which doesn't help with the weightiness of weapons it carries. Together with there is no lock mechanism in the arm connecting to shoulder, it is easy to let loose when you put on the heavy gun. It's a nightmare trying to pose with that Long Mega Buster.
The hip joint is not holding up well when you pick it up as well. It's a simple joint that requires some strengthening for safety.

Aside from those, after all, this is the Full Armor Hyaku Shiki Kai "ver Ka" that we deserve yet would never see from Bandai. Even if there is, the price tag would be something out of our reach. I'm happy Shenma has made this model kit and made it almost perfect.
I would recommend this model kit for every level of builders, new or experienced. It is just a beautiful attempt that I hope to see more in near future.
